$comment: Every document written to this collection must match this JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). backd adds the id and _meta fields itself, so don't declare them.

title.description: Post title. Required and never empty.

published.description: Whether readers can see the post.

category.description: Optional topic, e.g. "news". indexes.json indexes it for listing a category's posts.

author.description: Who wrote the post. Nested objects can be queried with dot paths, e.g. where={"author.email":"ada@example.com"}. collection.yaml checks that author.email is the writer's own email.
